text: now. [clears throat] I say that because I have preached before audiences in which there were witch doctors who were elders and pastors, and sometimes regular church members. They would literally go around and do evangelism, but at night in their homes, they would practice witchcraft and cast spells on other Christians. And because there are children here, I won't tell you what else they were doing. And if there is someone like that in this room or watching online, I want to

warn you. God sees everything that you are doing. And if you persist, a time will come when even though you may not hear it, a voice will be heard saying, It is finished. I can no longer plead. But at the same time, I want you to remember and to recall the greatest heretics like Manasseh, the great and proud Nebuchadnezzar, whom God was willing and able to save.

I know from someone I personally know the reason they kept on practicing the witchcraft and they kept on going back to the devil and asking him for power to cast spells on and to seduce people is because they were told by the devil, If you stop, I'm going to kill you and I'm going to kill your whole family. I have a word for you. The God of heaven is far greater than Satan. If you yield your life to Christ, Satan and his forces do not stand a chance. He always loses when confronted with

Christ and his angels. I could tell you stories about what Christ and his angels have done in real battles between angels and demons and the angels always won. When the one who was under attack yielded their lives to Christ, no matter how deep and how far they had gone into Satan and his cause, Christ was able to deliver and did deliver. But even if your case is not that extreme, but still you are stifling conscience, the word of the Lord comes today. If you hear his voice, harden not your heart.

Many will not be lost not because of great and terrible sins, but because of small compromises and indecision. And it is my hope and my prayer that we will hear the story of Belshazzar and Nebuchadnezzar and then we will lift up our eyes to heaven and say, Lord, help me. I believe, but help my unbelief. Deliver me from myself. Deliver me from the power of the enemy. And surely he will, he will. Never has a human heart made that cry and been denied by Jesus. I appeal to you to do the same.

Tis so sweet to trust in Jesus, just to take him at his word, just to rest upon his promise, just to know the steadfast love. Jesus, Jesus, how I trust him, how I prove him more and more. Jesus, Jesus, precious Jesus, oh, for grace to trust him more.

Just to trust his cleansing blood, just in simple faith beneath the healing, cleansing flood. Jesus, Jesus, how I trust him. How I prove him more and more. Just from sin and self to cease. Just from Jesus simply taking life and rest and joy and peace.

I want to present him now to each and every one as the friend of sinners, as the all compassionate one, the one who is our older brother who is not ashamed to call us brothers and sisters, who knows the strength and the power of our temptation.
I love the thrill that I feel when I get together with God's wonderful people. What a sight just to see all the happy faces praising God in heavenly places.

Let's talk about Jesus, the King of kings is he, the Lord of lords supreme through all eternity. The great I am, the truth, the light, the door. Let's talk about Jesus more and more. Sweet Jesus, what a wonder you are.
Precious, more precious than gold. I live for Jesus day after day. The Holy Spirit I will obey. Turn your eyes upon Jesus.
